class.name: LocalMultiplayerPeer
class.brief_description: An in-process [MultiplayerPeer] that routes packets through memory.
class.description: Works like [ENetMultiplayerPeer] without a network, for tests. Peers connect to the server only, not to each other. [codeblock] var server := LocalMultiplayerPeer.new() var client := LocalMultiplayerPeer.new() server.create_server() client.create_client(42) server.force_connect_peer(42, client) client.force_connect_peer(1, server) [/codeblock]

method.name: create_client
method.description: Makes this peer a client with the id [param client_id]. It is [constant MultiplayerPeer.CONNECTION_CONNECTING] until its first [method MultiplayerPeer.poll].

method.name: create_server
method.description: Makes this peer the server, with the id [param unique_id].

method.name: force_connect_peer
method.description: Connects this peer to [param peer], known as [param peer_id]. On the server, the next [method MultiplayerPeer.poll] emits [signal MultiplayerPeer.peer_connected].

method.name: is_linked_to
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when this peer is connected to [param peer_id].

method.name: linked_peer_ids
method.description: Returns the ids of every connected peer, in the order they connected.

members.member: The [LocalLoopbackSession] that simulates latency and loss for this peer.
